# Evaluation resources

These files were moved unchanged from the former `skill-creator` installation
in dotfiles commit `2828c0a32b6a2fdeda46e187c6a6b3c44136b8af`:

- `generate_review.py` and `viewer.html`: used by `../../review.py`.
- `grader.md`: the grading procedure referenced by `../../README.md`.
- `LICENSE.txt`: the original Apache 2.0 license.

The original package is from https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/skill-creator.
These are evaluation harness resources, with no `SKILL.md` or skill discovery entry.
Skill discovery and authoring use the installed `skillctrl` skill.
